snippet.description:
Learn Maxima and Minima of Two Variables with solved examples and step-by-step calculus methods. Master stationary points, saddle points, and extreme values for B.Sc Maths.

Iss video lecture mein hum Differential Calculus ka ek important chapter shuru kar rahe hain: Maxima and Minima of Two Variables (दो चरों के फलनों के उच्चिष्ठ और निम्निष्ठ मान). 

📌 Lectures ke key topics:
- One Variable vs Two Variables Maxima & Minima concept summary
- Necessary Conditions: First Order Partial Derivatives (∂f/∂x = 0, ∂f/∂y = 0)
- Sufficient Conditions: Second Order Partial Derivatives (r, s, t calculation)
- Nature of Stationary Points: Test for Maxima, Minima, and Saddle Point (पल्याण बिंदु) using (rt - s²)
- Doubtful case condition (rt - s² = 0)
- University exam oriented solved problems step-by-step
- Real-world application example: Minimum surface area / dimension of an open rectangular box

Timestamps:
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of 1-Variable Maxima/Minima
06:05 - Local vs Global Extrema
09:00 - Functions of Two Variables (3D Surfaces)
12:50 - Necessary Conditions for Extrema
15:05 - Sufficient Conditions (r, s, t & rt - s² Test)
22:40 - Algorithm Summary
26:00 - Solved Example 1: Algebraic Function
39:25 - Solved Example 2: Trigonometric Function
51:50 - Solved Example 3: Applied Problem (Open Box Dimensions)

Agar aapko kisi bhi step me doubt ho toh comment karke zaroor poochiye. Video ko like karein, share karein aur channel ko subscribe karna na bhulein!

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Evolute as Envelope of Normals: Solved Problems  → https://youtu.be/gEf4z9e8rbI

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨
